title: [MEDIUM] Governance decision authorization relies on relay ACL, not an engine-side admin check
description:
**File:** [`services/dream-engine/src/governance.rs`](https://github.com/DreamLab-AI/agentbox/blob/fix/dream-ledger-followup/blob/fix/services/dream-engine/src/governance.rs#L853-L884) (lines 853, 863, 884)
**Project:** agentbox-ledger-repairs
**Severity:** MEDIUM  •  **Confidence:** medium  •  **Slug:** `acl-check`

## Owners

**Suggested assignee:** `noreply@anthropic.com` _(via last-committer)_

## Finding

plan_decisions() accepts any kind-31403 (ACTION_RESPONSE) event as a valid operator decision provided only that (a) its Schnorr signature verifies, (b) it is not signed by the agent's own key (no self-review), and (c) its `e` tag binds the currently-published request. It never checks that the signer's pubkey belongs to a forum admin. The module doc explicitly states the admin constraint is enforced elsewhere: 'the relay already admits 31403 only from admins; the signature is re-verified here'. Signature verification in Nostr only proves key ownership, not role membership, so the admin trust boundary is entirely the relay's subscription-time ACL — a front-of-stack filter, exactly the kind the review guidance warns is insufficient on its own. If the engine ever queries a relay that does not enforce admin-only on 31403 (misconfiguration, relay swap via relay::relay_url(), a permissive fallback, or an attacker who obtains any keypair the relay happens to admit), an attacker can forge Approve/Reject/Amend decisions. Impact is bounded by design (decisions steer the next night's hypothesis, mark the inbox item answered/dismissed, and withdraw the case; nothing is auto-merged and TaskProperties declares the work Reversible/Bounded), which is why this is MEDIUM rather than HIGH — but an attacker could silently dismiss alerts, inject Amend free-text that becomes the next night's LLM guidance (prompt steering), and resolve/withdraw cases the operator never saw.

## Recommendation

Add a defence-in-depth admin allowlist check inside plan_decisions: carry the set of authorised admin pubkeys (from config/env) and require ev.pubkey to be a member before accepting a DecisionOutcome, rather than trusting the relay alone. Verify the resolution is derived only from admin-signed events, and log/ignore valid-but-unauthorised signatures.
